description: Stablecoin depeg monitor across 400+ USD, EUR, GBP and other stablecoins: which trade below their peg now and how badly, which are seeing fast redemptions (supply falling, often a run), which trade at a premium, and the status of the 10 largest. Optional Price: $0.005 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). In the free trial.

thresholdPercent.description: Distance from the peg (%) that counts as off-peg.

name: stablecoin-depeg

alerts.description: Newly depegged in the last hour, recovered since the last check, and since when the monitor has been tracking.

depegged.description: Below the peg by at least the threshold, worst first, with severity (minor, major 2%+, severe 5%+).

majors.description: The 10 largest USD stablecoins and their status.

premiums.description: Above the peg (usually yield-bearing tokens accruing interest).

redemptions.description: Supply down 5%+ in a day or 15%+ in a week.

status.description: alert = a $100M+ stablecoin is 2%+ below its peg.
